page.overview:
Who is Baudoin the Dragonslayer?

Baudoin the Dragonslayer was a King of Bretonnia and thus one of the mighty Grail Knights.

The most notable act of King Baudoin's rule occurred in the year 1245 IC, when he fought and slew the ferocious Dragon, Mergaste. A great fresco in the cathedral of Bastonne commemorated the heroic deed, and he was known thereafter as the "Dragonslayer."

Even after a thousand years had passed, the King's victory over the Dragon remained a celebrated part of Bretonnian history.
